---
title: "Question types: the 13 kinds of question surveyframe asks"
description: "The 13 answerable question types in surveyframe, from Likert and single choice to pairwise comparisons and criteria weights, with what each collects and the analyses it suits."
---

surveyframe asks 13 kinds of question, and 2 more elements lay the survey
out. Each type stores its answer in a declared shape, so the analysis plan
knows what it can do with it. The `input_types` demo holds all 13: open it
from RStudio's Addins menu with **surveyframe: Try a demo**.

| Type | What the respondent does | What it stores | Suits |
|---|---|---|---|
| Likert | Rates agreement on a labelled scale | 1 coded value | Scales, reliability, ordinal tests |
| Single choice | Picks 1 option | 1 code | Frequencies, cross-tabulations, group comparisons |
| Multiple choice | Picks any options | 1 column per option | Frequencies, Cochran's Q |
| Numeric | Types a number | A number | Descriptives, t-tests, regression |
| Short text | Types a line | Text | Text analysis |
| Long text | Types a paragraph | Text | Text analysis, topic models |
| Date | Picks a date | A date | Descriptives |
| Grid (matrix) | Rates several rows on 1 scale | 1 column per row | Descriptives, scales |
| Slider | Drags to a value | A number | Descriptives, correlation |
| Ranking | Orders options | The order | Rank descriptives |
| Star rating | Gives stars | A number | Descriptives, ordinal tests |
| Pairwise comparison | Judges which of 2 matters more, and by how much (Saaty), or how much 1 influences another (0 to 4) | 1 column per pair | AHP, ANP, DEMATEL |
| Criteria weights | Divides 100 points across criteria | 1 column per criterion | Decision methods |

The 2 layout elements are a **section break**, which starts a new page with
a heading, and a **text block**, which shows text and collects nothing.

Any question can be **required**, shown only when an earlier answer allows it
(**branching**), or checked for attention (**attention checks**).
